description: ADO-RESYNC on a client static batch-optimistic recordset of K: connection B updates L of ID 1, deletes ID 2 and inserts a row; after 8 s, Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncAllValues) and a read of all rows with Value/OriginalValue/UnderlyingValue/Status of L; a second external update of ID 1, 8 s, Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncUnderlyingValues) and the same reads; then Requery and Fields.Refresh with reads. Asks what Resync refreshes and whether it discovers inserts and deletes.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
